# Experimental design

<!-- Writers: T1 (arms, loss, equal updates, seeds), E2 (evaluation protocol, answer rule) · about 0.6 pages -->

*TODO (T1, E2).*

**Statistics.** We report every accuracy with a 95% Wilson interval [@wilson1927probable]. All runs answer the same 1,319 test questions, so we compare arms with paired differences [@miller2024errorbars] and a paired bootstrap over questions (10,000 resamples, fixed seed) [@efron1993bootstrap]. This interval covers the choice of test questions but not training noise, so we show each of the three seeds separately with their mean and range, and never select the best one. As a fidelity measure in the sense of @stanton2021does, we also report how often the student's final answer matches the teacher's, both overall and on the questions the teacher gets wrong.
